name: Drake, Mountain
body:
Mountain Drake CR 10

XP 9,600
LE Large dragon (earth)
Init +4; Senses dragon senses; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 9, flat-footed 22 (+13 natural,–1 size)
hp 125 (10d12+60)
Fort +10, Ref +7, Will +8
DR 5/magic; Immune cold, paralysis, sleep; SR 16

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (average)
Melee bite +13 (2d8+5), 2 claws +13 (2d6+5)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (70-ft. line, DC 21, 8d6 cold plus slow)

STATISTICS

Str 21; Dex 11; Con 17; Int 10; Wis 13; Cha 10
Base Atk +8; CMB +12; CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Fly +15, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Perception +17, Stealth +16
Languages Common, Draconic, Orc

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

At will, displacement

Breath Weapon (Sp)

The sleet breath weapon causes slow (DC 21) to all targets caught within the weapon.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold hills or mountains
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

A mountain drake is a closer cousin to the linnorms and wyrms than the true chromatic dragons.

A mountain drake’s breath weapon is a slushy, freezing line of sleet and hailstones.

Mountain drakes are wise enough to understand the strength they possess, and will use every tactic to their advantage. These drakes are highly protective of their domains, and also have a keen thirst for treasure. This often means that when a mountain drake takes up residence, it does so near a trading pass or outpost, and then extorts or robs to increase its golden horde. Mountain drakes often command tribes of orcs, assisting them in conquering others in order to maintain a constant supply of food and riches.

Mountain drakes are 20 feet long and weigh 2,500 pounds when fully grown. They appear shiny and have whitesh scales tinted with green. These drakes are bone-chilling to the touch, and frost and snow will accumulate near them when they are sedentary.
